title: Walk-in-interview for the post of Guest Lecturer in the Department of Geography, Bhaderwah Campus

text:

FULL TEXT:
Department of geography
Institute of Mountain Environment
Bhadarwah Campus
Jammu University
In-Charge Head
Faculty of Earth Sciences,
Institute of Mountain Environment,
Bhaderwah Campus, University of Jammu
No. BC/JU/PG/GEO/24/27
Date: 24.07.24
The eligible candidates are invited for walk-in-interview for the post of Guest Lecturer in the
Department of Geography, Bhaderwah Campus, University of Jammu. The appointment on the
post will be purely on temporary basis till further orders. Interested eligible candidates should
report at Office of the I/C Head, Department of Geography, Bhaderwah Campus for walk-in
interview on 26th July 2024 at 10:00 AM with all relevant educational documents and
testimonials in original.
In-Charge Head
Geography
TERMS & CONDITIONS
1. The Guest Lecturer shall be eligible for remuneration as per the University norms.
2. The candidate will not be entitled to any other benefits, which are admissible to the
regular employees of University of Jammu.
3. This engagement will not vest any right to claim for regular appointment in University of
Jammu or for continued services in the University.
4. The University reserves the right to terminate this engagement any time in case of
unsatisfactory performance, misconduct or any other administrative reasons/
compulsions.
5. In case of any dispute/ ambiguity that may occur in the process of selection, the decision
of the University shall be final.
6. Candidates must report at Bhaderwah Campus for Walk-In Interview on prescribed date
and time along with all supporting documents.
In-Charge Head
Geography
